notes.title: New Playtest Phase. Steam Deck and Steam Workshop
notes.content:
Hello, fellow island-builders!

We’re launching a new playtest phase and want you to help test some exciting features before full release. This is your chance to try what’s coming next — and shape the final version of Dragon Spot with your feedback.

Follow the game on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092560][b]Steam[/b][/url] page to stay updated:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185576/845ca9f8562a6a2a7c8e75022018b57c0198343c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185576/dcb47018384b4eed297e194a1a894d40c3419b85.png[/img]

Access will be granted once we hit 50 sign-ups!

🔧 What We're Testing:
[list]
[*] Steam Deck compatibility – does the game run smoothly in portable mode?
[*] Creative-to-Puzzle conversion – create islands in Creative Mode and turn them into puzzles for others.
[*] Steam Workshop integration – share your maps and download creations from other players.
[/list]
💬We Want Your Feedback:
[list]
[*] Does everything work well on Steam Deck?
[*] Is the puzzle-conversion tool easy to use?
[*] Any bugs or ideas about Steam Workshop?
[/list]
❤️ Thank You for Supporting Us!
Your feedback helps us improve Dragon Spot. If you enjoy the demo, please consider adding it to your Wishlist — this really helps indie games get noticed.

notes.title: Update 0.2a: More Control, Possibilities, and Much More
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are thrilled to present the next big update — 0.2a !
It adds new tools for Creative Mode, enhances controls, and makes the game even easier to use. Watch the timelapse video below to see all the changes in action!

[previewyoutube=_sMS8musLww;full][/previewyoutube]

What's new in Update 0.2a?
[list]
[*] Time of Day Settings: You can now change the time of day on your island. Create cozy sunsets or bright sunrises!
[*] Undo/Redo System (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y): Easily fix mistakes or experiment with designs. This also helps record stunning timelapses!
[*] Improved Camera Controls: The new system allows you to explore every corner of your island in detail.
[*] Experimental Steam Deck and Gamepad Support: Dragon Spot is now playable not only on PC but also on portable devices!
[*] Video Tutorials: We’ve added detailed video guides to help newcomers get started faster.
[*] Simplified Puzzle Mode: Building islands from blueprints has become much easier thanks to new mechanics.
[*] Bug Fixes: The game is now more stable and enjoyable than ever.
[/list]

This update brings even more convenience and excitement. With the day/night system, you can create unique atmospheres, easily undo mistakes, and even play on Steam Deck or with a gamepad.

Thank you for your support 💖
We sincerely appreciate your feedback and attention to the game. Thanks to you, Dragon Spot keeps getting better with each update! Share your impressions — we carefully read every message.

More information about the playtest:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3092560/view/4442333105001333847

Join our Discord channel to show off your creations in Creative Mode:
https://discord.gg/A2Eveayzu2

Don’t forget to add the game to your Wishlist on Steam 😏
Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Second Step. Update 0.10d: Creative Mode
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  
We’re thrilled to announce a major update and the next step in our open playtest!  

This time, we’ve introduced a Creative Mode that opens up endless possibilities. Create unique islands, place objects however you like, and build your own world! We’ve also added support for MacBooks on Apple Silicon, so even more players can join our community.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q9xTzRS.gif[/img]

What’s new in this update?  
[list]  
[*] Creative Mode: design and shape your islands as you wish.  
[*] Cross-platform saves for Creative Mode.  
[*] Steam Cloud support (cross-platform saves).  
[*] A level selection menu for easier navigation.  
[*] New decorations for human villagers to make their homes cozier.  
[*] House editor: now you can repaint and customize human buildings.  
[*] New models of trees, bushes, and other greenery.  
[*] Updated house models with more details.  
[*] New types of windows, doors, and stoves for added variety.  
[*] New activities for dragons to keep them entertained.  
[/list]  
[img]https://i.imgur.com/deMO24X.gif[/img]

Thank you for your support!  
We sincerely appreciate your feedback and dedication to the game. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update! Share your thoughts—we read every message.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185576/d8a9df5bbf335664a1dcbac86080c6a1dc743118.jpg[/img]

More info about playtest:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3092560/view/4442333105001333847

Join our Discord channel to share your creations in Creative Mode:  
https://discord.gg/A2Eveayzu2


Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist 😏
Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: What’s Ahead for Dragon Spot: Playtest Preview
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're getting ready to kick off the open playtest for Dragon Spot, and we’d like to let you know what to expect during this stage. This is your chance to be among the first to try out the game, and for us, it’s a great opportunity to gather your feedback and improve it even more. In this post, we’ll explain what will be available in the playtest and what features we plan to add in the future.

To gain access, request it on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092560][b]Steam[/b][/url] page. When the playtest becomes available, you will receive a notification and an email.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185576/dcb47018384b4eed297e194a1a894d40c3419b85.png[/img]
 
[h2]What will be available right away?[/h2]
As soon as the playtest begins, you’ll be able to try out the Puzzle Mode — the main gameplay mechanic where your task is to create an island based on a given example. This mode will be the starting point for testing the game and we’re excited to hear your feedback and impressions.

[h2]What are we planning to test?[/h2]
During the playtest, we’ll be gradually adding new features and improvements for you to try out. We’re already actively working on several key areas that will soon be available for testing. However, keep in mind that not all of these features are guaranteed to make it into the final release, and may be changed or removed.
[list]
[*] [h3]Photo Mode[/h3]
Take beautiful screenshots of your islands and share them with your friends. We can't wait to see your creativity!

[*] [h3]Creative Mode[/h3]
The ability to build islands without limitations — it's all in your hands.

[*] [h3]Gamepads and Steam Deck[/h3]
We want you to be able to play wherever you're most comfortable — whether it’s on your cozy couch, in a comfy gamer chair, or even in a hammock in the trees with your Steam Deck. Your feedback is especially important so we can make sure the game works well on different devices!

[*] [h3]macOS Support[/h3]
We’re impressed by the new devices from Apple and want the game to run smoothly on them as well. Currently, a version for Apple Silicon is available, and we’re continuing to work on optimizing the game for an even smoother experience.

[*] [h3]VR Version[/h3]
This is a separate version of Dragon Spot. We think it will be interesting to experience the game world from a new perspective and see how well the game works in virtual reality.
 
[*] [h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
We plan to add the ability to play with friends in a cooperative mode, where you’ll be able to build and create islands together. There may be separate modes for this in the future.

[*] [h3]Island Editor[/h3]
Create unique islands that other players will be able to see and play on.
[/list]     
[h3]Additional Improvements[/h3]
We’re also working on important features that will be added as they’re ready:
[list]
[*] Save System — so you can return to your creations at any time.
[*] Localization — adding new languages to reach a broader audience.
[*] Control Remapping — customizing controls to fit your preferences.
[*] Bug Fixes — we appreciate every bug report and are working on improving the game’s stability. 
[*] Achievements — a variety of challenges and goals to unlock, giving you more ways to enjoy and explore the game! 
[/list]
How can you help?
Your feedback and ideas are the driving force behind our improvements. We've created convenient channels for you to share your thoughts:

Our Discord for discussions: https://discord.com/invite/A2Eveayzu2


Follow the game on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092560][b]Steam[/b][/url] page to stay updated:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185576/845ca9f8562a6a2a7c8e75022018b57c0198343c.png[/img]

Also, add the game to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092560

We’re grateful to each participant for their support and involvement. Stay tuned for updates, and let’s make Dragon Spot even better together! 💖
